facts.text: Nearly 100 works of art are exhibited throughout the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Nearly 100 works of art are exhibited throughout The Artisan Hotel Istanbul – MGallery Collection

facts.text: The hotel's resident art collection includes works by local artists as well as works by globally renowned artists.
facts.excerpt: The resident collection gives you an opportunity to encounter traces of Istanbul and see works by local artists in addition to works by globally renowned artists.

facts.text: Richard Mas' sculptures of a woman and a man with heads shaped like lips welcome guests at the lobby entrance.
facts.excerpt: Richard Mas’ female and male sculptures with heads shaped like lips, recognized for his surrealist work playfully welcome you at the lobby entrance.

facts.text: Works of art are found in the rooms, corridors, convention halls, lobby and terrace.
facts.excerpt: Rooms, corridors, convention halls, lobby, and terrace -the works of art we encounter at each stride

facts.text: Inspired by the neighbourhood's historical buildings, the hotel reflects Art Nouveau design elements.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the historical buildings of the neighbourhood, The Artisan Istanbul MGallery reflects Art Nouveau design elements

facts.text: The boutique hotel sits on a quiet street between Taksim and Dolmabahce, a few steps from Istiklal Street and Pera.
facts.excerpt: Just a few steps from the most famous leisure district, Istiklal Street and Pera, lies a boutique hotel in a surprisingly quiet street from Taksim to Dolmabahçe

facts.text: The hotel is mere steps from the Bosphorus coast and within walking distance of Taksim.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located mere steps from the Bosphorus coast and within walking distance from Taksim.

facts.text: The hotel is a ten-minute drive from Karakoy, home to Galataport and Istanbul Modern Museum.
facts.excerpt: a ten-minute drive from Karakoy which is recently the most popular and vibrant neighbor, having Galataport and Istanbul Modern Museum

facts.text: Kabatas Pier, for ferries to the Princes' Islands, is a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: you could use **Pier Kabatas** for the ferry to Princes Island. It is from 5 minutes walking distance from The Artisan Hotel Istanbul – MGallery Collection.

facts.text: Kabatas tram station, with trams to the Old City, is a 7-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: you could take tram from  **Kabatas Station** which is only 7 minutes walking distance from the hotel to the Old City.

facts.text: The Artisan is part of MGallery, the Accor Group's premium category brand.
facts.excerpt: MGallery Collection, the premium category brand of the Accor Group

facts.text: The hotel offers a package with a professional photoshoot against a Bosphorus view, with costumes to rent.
facts.excerpt: This package includes a memorable photoshoot with gorgeous Bosphorus View. Rent any costume from any concept you want and enjoy this proffessional photoshoot with your loved ones

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as located at the heart of Istanbul.
facts.excerpt: a wonderful choice if you’re looking for a hotel located at the heart of Istanbul
